name: com.hotelpricesapi/hotel-rates-ota-price-comparison-mcp
title: HotelPricesAPI — Global Hotel Rates & OTA Price Comparison MCP
description: Real-time hotel prices, OTA rate comparison, room availability, reviews, and property metadata API.

tools.name: search_hotel_destinations
tools.description: Resolve any global city, neighborhood, or region name (e.g. "Paris", "Tokyo", "New York") into canonical location_id tokens, GPS coordinates, timezones, and available hotel counts. Cost: 2 Credits / call (0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: search_hotel_prices
tools.description: Search real-time hotel availability and nightly room rates for any global city or location_id across exact check-in/check-out dates, guest counts, and currency. Returns hotel_id, name, star rating, guest review_score, review_count, price_total, price_per_night, taxes_and_fees, coordinates, photos, and check-in windows. Cost: 2 Credits / hotel returned (0 Credits if empty).

checkin.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to +14 days).

checkout.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to +16 days).

currency.description: 3-letter ISO-4217 currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, etc.).

tools.name: get_hotel_rooms_and_detail
tools.description: Fetch complete property details and room-level offers for a specific hotel_id and stay window: exact room types, nightly & all-inclusive rates, refundable vs non-refundable cancellation policies, breakfast inclusion, Wi-Fi & breakfast review sub-scores, spoken languages, and facility counts. Cost: 10 Credits / call (0 Credits if not found).

adults.description: Number of adult guests for room occupancy pricing (1–12).

rooms.description: Number of rooms requested for availability check (1–8).

currency.description: 3-letter ISO-4217 currency code for room offers (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

tools.name: get_hotel_guest_reviews
tools.description: Retrieve verified guest stay reviews for a hotel_id, including numeric score, review title, pros, cons, travel purpose (leisure/business), date, and hotel management responses. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned (0 Credits if empty).

limit.description: Max reviews to return per page (1–25).

tools.name: compare_city_nightly_rates
tools.description: Run a fast 10-hotel rate-shopper snapshot for any global city to benchmark base nightly rates, excluded local taxes/fees, all-inclusive totals, star ratings, and guest scores. Cost: 2 Credits / hotel returned.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO-4217 currency code for rate comparison (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).
